notes: τὴν προσευχήν → the place of prayer keeps place of on the noun and gives the article a bare the: the ASV does not italicize place of, so it is read as the lexeme's own English expression (rule 99's ἀναστροφή → manner of life contrast) rather than a supplied nominal. Taking it as supplied and handing the place of to the article under rule 102, as an italicized supplied nominal would be, remains defensible.
The supplied complementizer that is placed on the infinitive ὑπαντῆσαι under rule 85, not on the matrix Ἐγένετο.
